title: Glowing yo-yo
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffff88' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#ffcc00' stop-opacity='0.4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff8800' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff4466'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#cc1144'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#880033'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='innerGrad' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffccdd'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ff6699'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#bb2255'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- String -->
  <line x1='50' y1='5' x2='50' y2='30' stroke='#66ffcc' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Yo-yo body outer ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='28' fill='#880033' stroke='#ff7799' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='28' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- Inner ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='20' fill='#660022' stroke='#ff99bb' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='20' fill='url(#innerGrad)'/>

  <!-- Spokes / design -->
  <g stroke='#ffddee' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'>
    <line x1='50' y1='37' x2='50' y2='73'/>
    <line x1='32' y1='55' x2='68' y2='55'/>
    <line x1='37.3' y1='42.3' x2='62.7' y2='67.7'/>
    <line x1='62.7' y1='42.3' x2='37.3' y2='67.7'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Center hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='8' fill='#ffe066' stroke='#fff4aa' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- Highlight sparkle -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='45' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.35' transform='rotate(-30 40 45)'/>

  <!-- Extra glow dots around -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='38' r='2' fill='#ffff88' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#ffff88' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='75' r='2' fill='#ffff88' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='72' r='2' fill='#ffff88' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
